verdict.rationale: Omnara offers a hosted dashboard/API/CLI/SDK to launch and manage agents without requiring inbound ports or exposing your network (omnara-docs-2, omnara-docs-21, omnara-probe-1/2/3), which supports a managed-cloud experience. However, docs also describe agents running on 'a machine you connect, such as a laptop or server' (omnara-docs-12), implying compute still runs on user-owned infrastructure rather than fully in Omnara's cloud, and community feedback frames it as a paid tunnel/orchestration layer over self-managed compute rather than a full backend replacement (omnara-comm-12, omnara-comm-14). Missing for 10: clear evidence of fully cloud-hosted agent execution (not just BYO machine), and independent confirmation of a no-infra-needed managed tier.
